verdict.rationale: A recorded runtime probe ran `npx -y skills add mattpocock/skills --skill tdd -a claude-code -y --copy` end to end in a scratch project. It installed the selected skill with no prompts, which shows an agent can run the install headlessly. Documented one-line CLI routes (`npx skills@latest add`, `claude plugin install`, `codex plugin add`, `copilot plugin install`) back this up. Missing for 10: first-party docs explicitly covering the non-interactive flags (`-y`, `--skill`, `-a`), since the docs describe an installer where you 'pick the skills and agents' and don't spell out a promptless mode.
